reporters.handoff: First, Edith on Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and twenty twenty-eight.

stories.topic: AOC says she would be done if she runs and loses in 2028
stories.script: Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez told the New York Times that if she runs in the twenty twenty-eight cycle, for the House, the Senate, or the White House, and does not win, she would be finished in elected office. She called it very all or nothing, and said she is not opposed to that outcome, but any campaign would have to make it worth it. The New York Post reports she has not decided whether to seek the presidency or a Senate seat, and expects to choose after the twenty twenty-six midterms while focusing first on winning a House majority.

reporters.signoff: I am Edith, for GLC News.

reporters.handoff: Thanks Edith. Isabella next, at the New York Stock Exchange.

stories.topic: Melania Trump to ring NYSE opening bell and launch IMPERIA
stories.script: First lady Melania Trump is scheduled Wednesday to ring the opening bell at the New York Stock Exchange. Coverage from the White House schedule and the New York Post says she will also headline the I.M.P.E.R.I.A. Summit from the exchange, launching an invite-only network for female chief executives and senior C-suite leaders focused on economic influence and collaboration. The appearance falls in a busy United Nations General Assembly week that also includes events tied to the Chinese state visit.

reporters.signoff: I am Isabella, for GLC News.

reporters.handoff: Thanks Isabella. Mark has two tech stories, starting with Meta's Muse.

stories.topic: Meta Muse adds Shopify and PayPal agentic checkout
stories.script: Meta's Muse personal A.I. agent is expanding into agentic shopping. MarketWatch and P.Y.M.N.T.S. report Shopify is enabling Shop Pay checkout so Muse can complete purchases across Shopify stores, and PayPal says customers will be able to shop and check out through Muse using PayPal. Meta launched Muse earlier this month as a personal assistant in its own app and WhatsApp. Executives frame the deals as giving users wider store access while keeping merchants on familiar checkout rails.

stories.topic: Apple postpones AI pendant; studies screenless fitness band
stories.script: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple has postponed work on an A.I. pendant with a camera, conceived as a pin or necklace that would feed visual context and microphone input to Siri. Prototypes were described as roughly AirTag sized in aluminum and glass. Separately, Apple is exploring a Whoop-like screenless fitness band with continuous health monitoring. That project is still early, with any launch unlikely before twenty twenty-eight if Apple moves ahead, MacRumors and Bloomberg say.

reporters.signoff: I am Mark, for GLC News.
